answer.summary: The worker process needs more memory than the 64 MiB limit while building the report, so the kernel kills it (OOMKilled, exit code 137).
next_checks: Re-run the container after the fix and watch its logs.

answer.explanation: Raise the memory limit from 64 MiB to 512 MiB so the report fits. Keep a limit so one container cannot starve the host.

answer.reason: Raising the memory limit addresses the OOM kill and keeps a limit in place.
